itens.titulo: Banco do Brasil lança 'Cofrinho de Proventos' para reinvestir dividendos de forma automática, mas tem um ponto de atenção
itens.descricao: Banco do Brasil lança 'Cofrinho de Proventos' para reinvestir dividendos de forma automática, mas tem um ponto de atenção Seu Dinheiro
trechos: A partir de 26 de outubro, clientes do banco estatal poderão investir automaticamente dividendos, juros sobre capital próprio (JCP) e rendimentos de fundos imobiliários (FIIs) em um cofrinho próprio para esse dinheiro.
Trata-se do "Cofrinho de Proventos", uma nova funcionalidade anunciada pela instituição nesta segunda-feira (19).
Segundo o Banco do Brasil, o fundo acumulou rentabilidade de 13,90% nos últimos 12 meses até setembro, ante 14,48% do CDI — o equivalente a cerca de 96% do indicador.
Entre as características do produto elencadas pelo Banco do Brasil estão: - aplicação mínima de apenas R$ 0,01; - resgate com crédito no mesmo dia (D+0); - taxa global de 0,5% ao ano.

Enquanto os Cofrinhos BB atingiram R$ 1 bilhão em patrimônio em fevereiro deste ano, o patrimônio do fundo superava R$ 3,6 bilhões em setembro, com 693,89 mil cotistas desde seu lançamento, em junho de 2024.

Enquanto os dividendos de ações e FIIs são isentos de imposto de renda para a maior parte das pessoas físicas e os JCP têm desconto de 15% direto na fonte, o fundo BB Renda Fixa Simples Reserva tem outra regra de tributação.
Os fundos de renda fixa têm incidência do chamado come-cotas duas vezes por ano, em maio e novembro, com alíquota de 15% sobre os rendimentos acumulados até então.

Além disso, no resgate, o investidor ainda pode pagar uma diferença de imposto para completar a alíquota final da tabela regressiva, que varia de 22,5% para aplicações de até 180 dias, 20% de 181 a 360 dias, 17,5% de 361 a 720 dias e 15% acima de 720 dias.

itens.titulo: MARA Holdings (MARA) Mined More Bitcoin, but Revenue Fell 27%
itens.descricao: MARA Holdings (MARA) Mined More Bitcoin, but Revenue Fell 27% Yahoo Finance
trechos: MARA Holdings (NASDAQ:MARA) mined 2,422 bitcoin in the second quarter, a little more than it mined a year earlier.
Yet revenue fell 27% to $174.9 million because the average price of each coin it produced was far lower.
MARA runs 19 data centers, most filled with machines that earn bitcoin by processing transactions, and it holds a large stash of the coin.
Investors who want more stocks like this can find MARA in our recent list, 9 Best Bitcoin Stocks to Buy Now.
MARA posted a net loss of $611.3 million in the second quarter, and $343.0 million of that came from marking its bitcoin down to market value.
Sales grew about 190.9% a year over the past five years, a long record of growth.
But over the past 12 months MARA lost $3.46 billion on $804.22 million in sales, so the growth never reached profit.
MARA is waiting on regulatory approval for Long Ridge, a power plant with more than 70% of its output sold under long-term contracts.

itens.titulo: The 10-year Treasury yield is above 5%. Should savers lock in now?
itens.descricao: The 10-year Treasury yield is above 5%. Should savers lock in now? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Treasury yield closed at 5.09% on Friday, according to the Treasury's daily par yield curve.
Yields have retreated from recent highs but remain above 5% as concerns about persistent inflation and potentially higher interest rates continue to put pressure on markets.

However, whether a 10-year Treasury note is a worthwhile investment highly depends on your savings goals, when you'll need access to your money, and your tolerance for the risk of selling if rates change.

"If you are waiting on the Fed to push rates higher before you lock anything in, I would ask what exactly you are waiting for," said David Kassir, managing director of Private Wealth Management, Manna Wealth Management.
Say you invest $1,000 in a 10-year Treasury note yielding approximately 5.1%.
Your investment would generate an annualized return of about $51, assuming you hold the note to maturity.
You can sell a 10-year Treasury note before maturity through a bank, broker, or dealer.
If you buy through TreasuryDirect, you must hold the note for at least 45 days before transferring it for sale.

itens.titulo: Better Oil Stock: Chevron (CVX) vs. ExxonMobil (XOM)
itens.descricao: Better Oil Stock: Chevron (CVX) vs. ExxonMobil (XOM) Yahoo Finance
trechos: Over the past 12 months, Chevron's stock has rallied 45% while ExxonMobil's stock has risen 58%.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
However, Chevron generates more of its profits (about 80%) from its upstream business than ExxonMobil (about 70%).

However, the price of Brent crude oil -- currently at $110 per barrel -- remains far above ExxonMobil's breakeven price (for covering capex and dividends) of $35 per barrel and Chevron's breakeven price of $50 per barrel.
Both companies plan to increase their oil and gas production by about 3% annually through the end of the decade.
Chevron pays a forward yield of 3.2%, while ExxonMobil pays a lower forward yield of 2.3%.
Chevron has raised its dividend annually for 39 consecutive years, while ExxonMobil has maintained that streak for 43 years.

itens.titulo: TSMC’s Profit Soars 69%, but Can its Next Chip Breakthrough Justify the Valuation?
itens.descricao: TSMC’s Profit Soars 69%, but Can its Next Chip Breakthrough Justify the Valuation? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Its transition to two-nanometer manufacturing has begun to squeeze margins, and yet third-quarter net income and diluted EPS both grew 68.7%, and the company's forecast points to another substantial increase in sales before the year is over.
Yahoo Finance's latest available valuation statistics place the stock's shares at 21.41 times forward earnings.
Bull Case Revenue reached NT$1.49 trillion in the September quarter, up 50.9% from a year earlier, while net profit increased 68.7% to NT$763.06 billion.
The company also reported that operating income rose 75%.

Growth of that magnitude would be notable on its own, but TSMC also exceeded the top of its previous US-dollar revenue guidance, which was $46.72 billion against a forecast range of $44.6 billion to $45.8 billion.
Chips made using seven-nanometer or more advanced technologies contributed 79% of wafer revenue.
Two-nanometer technology already represented 8%, up from just 3% three months earlier, and high-performance computing accounted for 68% of total revenue.
Cash generation confirms the strength, as the company reported that net cash generated from operating activities totaled NT$919.77 billion in fiscal Q3, and free cash flow rose to NT$476.56 billion.

itens.titulo: Intel’s AI Growth Is Accelerating. Can Packaging Add More Upside?
itens.descricao: Intel’s AI Growth Is Accelerating. Can Packaging Add More Upside? Yahoo Finance
trechos: On July 24, the company announced a memorandum of understanding with China-based Lens Technology to explore glass substrate packaging for future AI and data center workloads.
If you want to find out the 8 stocks that are even better than Intel, you can read the full post here: Top 10 Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) Stocks to Buy in 2026.
Second-quarter revenue rose 25% YoY to $16.1 billion, while Data Center and AI revenue jumped 59% to $6.3 billion.
However, Intel also reported an $11 billion GAAP net loss, highlighting the gap between its improving operating momentum and reported profitability.
Intel also reported growing customer interest in its EMIB-T advanced packaging technology, with a growing backlog and plans to ramp production to support customer programs in 2027.
The company hasn't named the customers behind that backlog, and it raised its 2026 capital spending outlook to more than $20 billion.

Its forward non-GAAP P/E of 67.48x is about 9% above its five-year average of 62.01x, while its forward price-to-sales ratio of 8.56x is nearly 168% above its historical average of 3.19x.
